title: Photo of five men posing on a mountain overlook (23.11.2011)
summary: A full-slide photograph of five men standing side by side with arms around each other at a brick-walled overlook, with bare desert mountains and a blue inlet of water behind them. An orange date stamp reads 23.11.2011 15:55.

pictures.description: Color snapshot of five men standing in a row at a low brick-and-tile railing in front of dry, rocky desert mountains and a blue bay or sea inlet, with late-afternoon sun and a lens flare at upper right. From left: an older bald man with a white beard in a blue-and-white jacket; a man in a baseball cap and grey T-shirt; a man in a black shirt and khaki trousers with a small waist bag; a young man in a black T-shirt with an astronaut graphic; and a man in a grey Texas A&M sweatshirt. An orange camera date stamp is in the lower right.

uncertain: Location and the identities of the men are not stated on the slide; they are not identified.
